heading: External wall
context: Requirements for External Wall, Cladding and Curtain Wall
content:
27.
External wall
(1)
An external wall of a building must be constructed of materials that are—
(a)
permanent and impervious; and
(b)
non-combustible materials.
(2)
Adequate means of access to the outer surface of an external wall of a building or a projection from the wall must be provided for the maintenance or repair of the wall or projection.
